display_long_description:
💬 Join the Discord: discord.gg/MZXNwzVRsN

You're a monke with a plot of land and $150. Build the richest mine in VR.

⛏️ Droppers, belts, upgraders & furnaces turn ore into CASH
🖐️ Grab machines off your wrist tablet and THROW them onto your plot
💎 100+ machines, including gambling machines and secret exclusives
🔄 Rebirth to get stronger and unlock exclusive machines
💤 Your mine keeps earning while you're offline
🏆 Leaderboards & Hall of Fame statues: flex on everyone
🎩 Hats, faces, glowing hands, swing trails & base themes
🐾 Pets, daily gifts, quests, crates & treasure chests
👥 Up to 6 players, voice chat, private rooms with a code

HOW IT WORKS
Droppers spit out ore. Belts carry it. Upgraders multiply what it's worth. Furnaces turn it into cash. Grab a mini machine off your wrist tablet, aim at your plot and let go. It flies out of your hand and lands on the grid. After a rebirth your old layout rebuilds itself.

Climb the boulders and hunt down treasure chests that refill every day. Everyone gets their own plot, and nobody can touch your plot or your cash.

Gorilla Tag-style arm movement. Free to play. We're updating it all the time, so tell us what breaks in the Discord!
